Meeting Date:                 4/27/2022
Sponsor(s):                   Scott, Jr. (24)
Type:                         Ordinance
Title:                        Zoning Reclassification Map No. 4-1 at 1933-1935 S Kedzie
                              Ave
Committee(s) Assignment:      Committee on Zoning, Landmarks and Building Standards
                                      ORDINANCE



BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance, be amended by changing all ofthe B3-2,
Community Shopping District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 4-1 In the
area bound by:

      South Kedzie Avenue; a line 321.74 feet south ofand parallel to West 19'" Street; the
      alley next east of and parallel to South Kedzie Avenue; and a line 371.74 feet south of
      and parallel to West 19"' Street,

to those ofa B2-1, Neighborhood Mixed-Use District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.




                                                          Michael Scott Jr.
                                                          Alderman, 24*'' Ward




Common Address:
1933-1935 S. Kedzie Avenue
